cases.topic: Planning an Indonesia school kitchen project
cases.business_objective: Explain a governed project delivery approach for school decision makers
cases.evidence: Sari Arta supports public school kitchen planning through requirement discovery, layout coordination, manufacturing coordination, Indonesia installation coordination, commissioning support, and after-sales follow-up.

cases.scenario: 印度尼西亚学校厨房项目
cases.topic: 印度尼西亚学校厨房项目规划
cases.business_objective: 向学校决策人员说明受治理的项目交付方式
cases.call_to_action: 申请学校厨房项目咨询
cases.evidence: Sari Arta 通过需求梳理、布局协调、制造协调、印度尼西亚本地安装协调、调试支持和售后跟进，为学校厨房项目提供公开服务信息。

cases.topic: What to review before a school canteen renovation
cases.business_objective: Create a concise educational video for school facility teams
cases.evidence: Sari Arta publicly recommends that school canteen renovation planning starts with workflow, available space, utilities, installation access, and operating continuity requirements.

cases.topic: 学校食堂改造前需要确认什么
cases.business_objective: 为学校设施团队制作简洁的教育短视频
cases.call_to_action: 咨询您的学校食堂改造项目
cases.evidence: Sari Arta 的公开建议是，学校食堂改造规划应先确认工作流程、可用空间、公用工程条件、安装通道和持续运营需求。

cases.topic: A coordinated factory canteen project workflow
cases.business_objective: Show factory teams the stages of an engineering-led canteen project
cases.call_to_action: Request a factory canteen project review
cases.evidence: Sari Arta presents a public factory canteen delivery workflow covering requirements, kitchen layout, equipment coordination, logistics planning, local installation coordination, and commissioning support.

cases.topic: 工厂食堂工程的协调交付流程
cases.business_objective: 向工厂团队展示工程型食堂项目的主要阶段
cases.call_to_action: 申请工厂食堂项目评估
cases.evidence: Sari Arta 的公开工厂食堂交付流程包括需求梳理、厨房布局、设备协调、物流规划、本地安装协调和调试支持。

cases.topic: Why hospital kitchen projects need coordinated planning
cases.business_objective: Introduce the project-planning discussion to institutional facility teams
cases.evidence: Sari Arta describes hospital and institutional kitchen projects as coordinated engineering work involving operational requirements, workflow, layout, equipment scope, utilities, installation, and commissioning review.

cases.topic: 医院厨房项目为什么需要协同规划
cases.business_objective: 向机构设施团队介绍项目规划讨论重点
cases.call_to_action: 申请机构厨房项目咨询
cases.evidence: Sari Arta 将医院和机构厨房项目描述为协同工程工作，涉及运营需求、工作流程、布局、设备范围、公用工程、安装和调试评估。

cases.topic: Starting a central kitchen capacity planning discussion
cases.business_objective: Invite project owners to prepare the inputs required for an engineering consultation
cases.call_to_action: Schedule a central kitchen planning consultation
cases.evidence: Sari Arta publicly advises that central kitchen capacity planning should consider menu, production periods, process flow, storage, utilities, site constraints, installation access, and future operating requirements before equipment scope is confirmed.

cases.topic: 如何开始中央厨房产能规划讨论
cases.business_objective: 邀请项目业主准备工程咨询所需的基础信息
cases.call_to_action: 预约中央厨房规划咨询
cases.evidence: Sari Arta 的公开建议是，在确认设备范围之前，中央厨房产能规划应考虑菜单、生产时段、工艺流程、存储、公用工程、现场限制、安装通道和未来运营需求。
